== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Aurra Sing (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1250_2</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 02), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-02-Aurra_Sing.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-aurrasing-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Aurra Sing (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1005_L6106</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>11_51</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
